money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: Serbia's currency is the Serbian Dinar (RSD). You can't change it outside Serbia. On arrival, you'll need to declare currency and valuables worth 10,000 euros or equivalent value. Valuables may include: laptops cameras jewellery Make sure you get a copy from customs officials. You'll need the declaration form when you leave Serbia. They could be taken away if you don't declare your currency or valuables. Most banks in towns and cities have ATMs that accept international bank cards. ATMs only dispense Serbian Dinar. In limited locations, ATMs may dispense euros. Traveller's cheques aren't widel
